_about: The process tree and Claude Code pid files, as the resolvers read them: SessionResolver.parsePS and
xplat/herdr-core/tests/resolver_vectors.rs. ps text is in UTC (as from another machine with TZ=UTC0).
Synthetic: no real hosts, users or sessions.

ps.name: a macOS line with its environment
a one-digit day is padded with a space
several lines, blank ones skipped
ps.text:
899     1 Fri Nov 27 17:20:59 2026 -bash
  900   899 Fri Nov 27 17:21:07 2026 claude
  950   900 Fri Nov 27 17:22:00 2026 node /usr/lib/node_modules/x/mcp.js

ps.name: spaces inside the command are kept
no command but trailing spaces: skipped
a pid that is not a number: skipped
ps.text: PID  PPID STARTED COMMAND x y z w

ps.name: a day the month does not have: skipped
the weekday is not checked against the date
